scheme_name: Reimbursement of Expenses for Startups Operating from Leased/Privately Owned Premises Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a start‑up certified by the Start‑up Promotion Cell (SPC) with a valid start‑up certificate number
The start‑up must not use any government‑developed co‑working spaces, incubators or accelerators for its operations
Only expenditures incurred after the notification of Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 and paid digitally will be considered (SPC may admit non‑digital payments as per its guidelines)
Local start‑up definition: at least 50 % equity/share held by one or more Goans continuously since inception
‘Goan’ means a person born in Goa, or a person with domicile in Goa for 10 + years, or the spouse of such a person (marriage registered in Goa)
Application must be submitted within six months of incurring the relevant expenditure
benefits_summary: Reimbursement up to ₹1 lakh per quarter for internet connectivity, software licence and cloud service expenses; for local start‑ups renting premises, a lease‑rental subsidy of up to ₹20 per sq ft per month (capped at ₹3 lakh per annum).
